from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashBalance(BaseModel):
    """Cash and cash equivalents reported in one company's financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company this filing belongs to")
    cash_balance: float | None = Field(description="The cash amount in actual dollars (not thousands or millions)")
    cash_balance_reported: str | None = Field(description="How the amount was written in the document (e.g., '1,956' or '$7,963,173')")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale in the document: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the balance was as of")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt from the balance sheet showing the cash line item")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cash_balances: list[CompanyCashBalance]
